q: Is carbon black exported to the EU covered by CBAM?
title: Is carbon black in CBAM?
short: No. Carbon black is declared under 2803, and the only chapter 28 product in Annex I is hydrogen. EU tyre and rubber buyers file no CBAM figure for it, but many ask for a product footprint because carbon black is carbon intensive.
audience: Carbon black producers in India supplying EU tyre and rubber makers

p: A cradle to gate footprint per tonne: feedstock oil, process gas use, tail gas combustion and power, with any exported power or steam credited by a stated method.
The Commission proposed in December 2025 to extend CBAM to some downstream steel and aluminium products. As of October 2026 that is not law, so check Annex I again before each contract season.

senseible: Senseible reads your fuel and electricity invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so if a buyer asks for a product footprint you can answer from documents rather than estimates.
